name: Glossary
summary: Checks the subtitles against your team's glossary and offers the preferred term.
description: List the terms your team avoids, each with the term to use instead, and every Line that uses one shows a problem in the Problems list, a squiggle in the line editor and a mark in the Grid. Quick fix puts the preferred term in. A Project can keep its own glossary.

settings.title: Glossary
settings.description: One term per row: the term to avoid, then → (or ->) and the term to use, such as “e-mail → email”. A term alone is flagged with no fix.
